sections.heading: A useful conversation starts with a little context.

items.title: For course enquiries
items.description: Share your background, the skills you want to learn and the program you are considering. Ask about current fees and schedules.

items.title: For service enquiries
items.description: Describe your audience, goal and current website or marketing activity. Include any timeline or scope requirements.

items.title: For a campus visit
items.description: Call ahead to confirm availability and discuss what you would like to explore during your visit.

items.question: Where is the academy located?
items.answer: The academy is at the 2nd Floor, Pink Hives Building, Plot No. B-2/425, Sector 2, Chitrakoot Scheme, Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302021.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: The listed hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM IST. Please call ahead to confirm availability before visiting.

items.question: What should I include in my enquiry?
items.answer: Include your contact details, the program or service you are interested in, and a brief description of your goals. Avoid including sensitive personal information.

items.question: Can I enquire without choosing a program?
items.answer: Yes. Leave the program selection open and describe what you want to learn. The team can help you compare the available paths.
